reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was the QR code and "Every batch lab-tested", which is a nice touch, but it is not an NSF or USP seal, and there are no reviews at all. I would stay with Pure Encapsulations or Thorne, and $1 a serving is a lot for a brand I have never heard of.
objection: No reviews and no NSF or USP seal, at about five times the price per serving of Nature Made or Double Wood. A lab report the brand itself links to is not the same as third-party certification.
would_change_my_mind: A few hundred verified reviews with a solid rating, plus an NSF or USP certification, or a price closer to $18-20 for 30 sachets.
